lead: `bun nv proofs --verify --group` prints only the gate while any member of the group still owes a proof, so a new attack that does not compile stays hidden.
body: `tools/nv/cmd/proofs.ts` stops at its "still owe a proof" list, and a group sweep there listed `Core\Session::set` as owing nothing while its attack failed with `E0406`; only `--verify --id '<member>'` ran it and printed the failure. Run `--verify --id` for each member you wrote proofs for before trusting a group run that is still red for other members.
